name: trader_inventory
description: What each trader contact in the sky buys and sells: item or gas name, prefab, credits per unit, how many it wants or has in stock, the conditions a sold-to-it item or gas must meet (purity, moles per unit, temperature range), and for each line it buys how many units of what you hold meet its conditions (have, not capped by wanted, as the game's own sellable count is not: the goods on the pad network's vending machines and in the card holder's inventory that meet its conditions, as trader_sell takes them, so a 'Box of ...' line counts only the boxes whose contents it accepts; for a gas line the pad network's gas in units when the gas meets its conditions; the pad is the one the contact is called to, or every landing pad's network for a contact not called yet; the card holder is credit_card_id's holder, else the player) and, for the landed trader only, how many it would take right now (sellable: what the pad network's vending machines and you carry that meets its conditions, or the pad network's gas in units, the trade window's own count; trader_sell counts the same with the card holder's inventory in place of yours, so the two agree when the card is yours; null for a contact not landed). The game rolls a trader's inventory when the contact appears, so this works before the trader is interrogated. Omit contact_id for every contact. Refusals: invalid_argument, contact_not_found, card_not_found, card_not_usable. Read only; no gateway is needed.

contact_id.description: Reference ID of one trader contact (see trader_contacts); omit for all.

credit_card_id.description: The credit card whose holder's inventory counts toward have, as trader_sell takes goods from it; default the player's inventory.
